content.title: Chapter 50 - DRAINAGE AND STORMWATER QUALITY — Sec. 50-53. - Site disturbance permit fee.
content.summary:
Before a permit is issued pursuant to this article, the applicant shall pay to the
               city a site disturbance permit fee in an amount set forth in the public works administrative
               fees and costs schedule.
(
Ord. No. 4875
, § 1, 8-19-2024)
